style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.nm_crooked_again: The manor on its hill at night with every line bent again, purple slime running down the clapboard, one window flashing red then black
pictures.nm_crooked_again_2: A red dog barrelling out of writhing bushes and knocking a small girl down on a heaving porch step
pictures.nm_house_shatters: A perfect foyer, chandelier lit, with a body dropping into frame from above on a rope
pictures.nm_house_shatters_2: The foyer bursting outward into a whirl of walls, furniture, a bathtub and a moose head, all hanging in the dark
pictures.nm_house_shatters_3: The floor crumbling into a bottomless pit, the attic floorboards far above through tumbling debris
pictures.nm_noose_runs_out: A crooked top-hatted silhouette jerked to a halt by his rope as the party drops past below
pictures.nm_noose_runs_out_2: His grin shrinking away above in the dark
pictures.nm_three_adelas_a: A little girl in a white dress yanked backwards into the trees by nothing, a doll falling in the leaves
pictures.nm_three_adelas_a_2: White handprints glowing on the trunks of an autumn wood under a full moon, the clearing empty
pictures.nm_three_adelas_b: A teenage girl shooting up from a smoking crater into the sky
pictures.nm_three_adelas_b_2: A new twinkling star among the others over a city's lights across a bay
pictures.nm_three_adelas_c: A bride in a crown of roses going up in flame on her dais
pictures.nm_three_adelas_c_2: Masked wedding guests torn apart in the firelight of a moonless meadow
pictures.nm_pulled_out: A swirl of blue mist round a hand reaching out of the dark
pictures.nm_pulled_out_2: Outside at a porch, a small girl with her eyes closed, a thread of blue light running from her hands into a crooked house
pictures.nm_cauldron_births: Thousands of vermin rippling as one over the walls of an attic
pictures.nm_cauldron_births_2: A brew boiling over in a clawed cauldron and slithering up into a three-headed thing of weasel, centipede and pigeon
pictures.nm_cauldron_births_3: The clawed cauldron taking its first step across a floor of sigils
pictures.nm_dreaming_no_more: A manor folding in on itself floor by floor in a cloud of dust
pictures.nm_dreaming_no_more_2: Rubble under a cloudless sky, ghosts swirling round it like wasps round a broken nest, a calm little girl standing in the middle
pictures.nm_dreaming_no_more_3: A butler's ghost nodding once, then joining the swirl
pictures.nm_sally_goes_free: A pale girl's shape lifting out of a red dog
pictures.nm_sally_goes_free_2: The dog shaking himself, an ordinary dog now, licking a small girl's hand
